name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, plus selectable monochrome Gen 1 and Crystal-based Gen 2 backgrounds in the five GBA games. Completes Crystal-style Pacifidlog, Verdanturf and Fallarbor; adds 43 distinct Crystal berry plants with native growth frames and matching dirt. Fixes Gym roofs/signs/windows, Mauville fences/bikes, entrance roofs, rock corners and Mart roof seams. Other GBA areas remain partial. Original entrances, collision, actor positions and game mechanics are preserved.
